entries.title: Women and generative AI: The adoption gap is closing fast, but a trust gap persists
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that women's use of generative AI will equal or exceed that of men in the United States by the end of 2025.
entries.metric: US women's gen AI use vs men's
entries.subject: Generative AI adoption by gender

entries.title: As generative AI asks for more power, data centers seek more reliable, cleaner energy solutions
entries.quote: AI-driven data center power consumption will continue to surge, with Deloitte predicting data centers will only make up about 2% of global electricity consumption by 2025.
entries.metric: data center share of global electricity consumption
entries.subject: Data center electricity use

entries.title: Ambitious stadium projects aim to bridge public-private investment goals
entries.quote: In 2025, we expect to see new stadium developments continue at pace, with almost half of these new projects expected to take place across North America and Europe.
entries.metric: share of new stadium projects in North America and Europe
entries.subject: Sports stadium investment

entries.title: Autonomous generative AI agents: Under development
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that in 2025, 25% of companies that use gen AI will launch agentic AI pilots or proofs of concept, and this figure will grow to 50% in 2027.
entries.metric: gen AI-using companies launching agentic AI pilots
entries.subject: Agentic AI

entries.title: Deepfake disruption: A cybersecurity-scale challenge and its far-reaching consequences
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that this market will follow a similar pattern as that of cybersecurity, with bad actors finding ways to thwart detection tools and industries collaborating to confirm the credibility of at least some online content.
entries.subject: Deepfake detection

entries.title: Cloud gets lean: 'FinOps' makes every dollar work harder
entries.quote: in 2025 Deloitte predicts more companies than ever will turn to "FinOps", a set of tools and strategies to measure and optimize cloud spend, to save an estimated US$21 billion.
entries.subject: Cloud cost management (FinOps)

entries.title: On-device generative AI could make smartphones more exciting—if they can deliver on the promise
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that in 2025, global smartphone shipments will see a modest lift to around 7%, up from about 5% annual growth in 2024.
entries.subject: Smartphone shipments

entries.title: Large studios will likely take their time adopting generative AI for content creation. Social media isn't hesitating.
entries.quote: In 2025, Deloitte predicts that the biggest TV and film studios ... will be cautious in adopting generative AI into their creative workflows, with less than 3% of their production budgets going to these tools.
entries.metric: share of major studio production budgets on gen AI tools
entries.subject: Generative AI in film and TV production

entries.title: Reevaluating direct-to-consumer: The shift toward video aggregators
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that the stack is about to get shorter ... the number of standalone services will slowly decline in most markets.
entries.subject: Streaming video aggregation

entries.title: Wireless telecom consolidation speeds up … where regulators allow
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that although it is expected to be a slow process, and regulators will have their conditions, there will be an increased pace of consolidation, beginning in 2025
entries.subject: Wireless telecom consolidation

entries.title: Generative AI comes to the enterprise edge: 'On-prem AI' is alive and well
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that although gen AI via cloud will continue to be the dominant option in 2025, about half of the enterprises worldwide will add AI data center infrastructure on premises
entries.subject: On-premises AI infrastructure

entries.title: (Re)defining the investment case for women's sports
entries.quote: In 2024, we predicted the women's elite sports market would generate over $1 billion in revenue.
entries.subject: Women's sports
entries.note: Update item; restates the 2024 prediction and reports valuations. No new numeric prediction in the summary.

entries.title: Fixed wireless access: Contrary to popular opinion, adoption may continue to grow
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts global FWA net additions will rise by 20% annually in 2025 and 2026 (in line with our 2022 Prediction on FWA)
entries.metric: annual growth in global FWA net additions
entries.subject: Fixed wireless access

entries.title: 5G standalone appears to be at a standstill: Will 6G run late?
entries.quote: In 2025, Deloitte predicts that fewer than 20 additional networks will be upgraded to standalone, keeping 5G SA at around 12% of all 5G deployments.
entries.subject: 5G standalone networks

entries.title: Open RAN mobile networks and vendor choice: Single vendor now, multivendor when?
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that no additional multivendor Open RAN networks will be deployed or announced in 2025.
entries.subject: Open RAN and network virtualization

entries.title: Despite quantum's slow start, don't be slow to start your defense against it
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that the number of companies, and the dollars spent, working on implementing post quantum cryptography standards will quadruple in 2025 compared with 2023.
entries.subject: Post-quantum cryptography

entries.title: RISC-V: Closing the geopolitical gen AI loophole
entries.quote: As predicted in Deloitte's 2022 Global TMT Predictions report, open-source RISC-V ... CPU chips revenues are expected to be close to US$1 billion by 2024.
entries.subject: RISC-V

entries.title: Generative AI and cyber: Big risks, but big opportunities too
entries.quote: Gen AI-based cyberattacks look like they will have doubled or tripled in 2024, and Deloitte predicts they will grow again in 2025
entries.subject: Generative AI and cybersecurity

entries.title: Silicon building blocks: Chiplets could move Moore's Law forward
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts worldwide advanced packaging revenue based on chiplets will more than double from an estimated US$7 billion in 2021 to reach US$16 billion in 2025.
entries.subject: Chiplets

entries.title: B/OSS: Telcos modernize their business and operational support systems software
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that the global B/OSS market will reach $70 billion by 2025, growing at 5% annually.
entries.subject: Telco support systems software

entries.title: Silicon photonics: Gen AI communicates at lightspeed
entries.quote: Deloitte predicts that sales of silicon photonics chips used as optical transceivers will grow at a compounded annual growth rate of 25% from 2023 to 2025 to reach US$1.25 billion in 2025.
entries.subject: Silicon photonics

notes: 24th edition by count from 2002. Ten main predictions plus 11 'mini predictions' (seven Updates revisiting past predictions, four Rising trends), as stated in the introduction; section field marks which. Quotes from the introduction page summaries. The Updates section is Deloitte's own review of past predictions (see INDEX.md). datePublished 2024-11-18 from page metadata.
